entities.summary: Bernard Patrick Morris was a Canadian professional ice hockey player. He played for the Seattle Metropolitans of the Pacific Coast Hockey Association (PCHA) from 1915 to 1923. When the Metropolitans became the first U.S.-based team to win the Stanley Cup in 1917, Morris scored 14 of Seattle's goals. Morris also played for the Calgary Tigers, Boston Bruins, and various minor league teams.
